capgo.body: Mimesis is Capgo's reference app: a Vue app on iOS and Android with Capacitor, updated live and published to the stores on every commit.
capgo.live.body: every new version reaches your phone without waiting on the stores.
capgo.live.label: Live updates
capgo.nav.body: a Liquid Glass tab bar on iOS and Material on Android.
capgo.nav.label: Native navigation
capgo.offline.body: the cards stay on the phone, so you can play with no connection.
capgo.offline.label: Offline
capgo.title: Open source, built with Capgo

hero.lead: The charades game for nights with friends and family. One phone, teams, zero words, and guaranteed laughs.
hero.title: Mime it. They guess!
how.lead: No board, no cards to shuffle. Mimesis handles the teams, the timer, and the scores.
how.mime.body: No talking, singing, or writing. Each card your team finds scores a point.
how.mime.title: Mime without a word
how.teams.body: At least two teams of two players. Mimesis picks the next mime each turn.
how.teams.title: Make the teams
how.theme.body: Idioms, rebus, art, unlikely situations… hundreds of cards to act out.
how.theme.title: Pick a theme
how.title: How to play
